notes.title: The release is delayed to May 8
notes.notes:
I am very sorry, but it is impossible to release the game today. I found a game-breaking bug that requires some time to fix.
But don't worry, it is only a brief delay. The game will be definitely released on May 8.

notes.title: The release is planned to May 4
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. I would like to apologize for the delay. Right now the game is playable, but it is still too early to present it to players.
Don't worry, the game will be fully complete by May 4.
